messages.subject: CPD seminar: Restructuring Plans after the latest Court of Appeal guidance
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

Join our restructuring team for a lunchtime CPD session on the latest cross-class cram-down decisions and what they mean for consensual deals. Thursday 26 March, 12:30, Training Room 2, sandwiches provided. 1 hour CPD. Register via the intranet.

Knowledge & Learning
